description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Morophon.
When Morophon dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger from step 3, returning Morophon from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Morophon enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Morophon trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
